request: Pull the last month of significant earthquakes from the USGS GeoJSON summary feed. Flatten each event to mag, place, event_time (ISO from epoch ms), alert, tsunami flag, magType, lon/lat/depth, and a felt-count enrichment. Publish to 'Prep Agent / 15 - USGS Significant Earthquakes' on Tableau Server for global-events / DoD site-risk analysts.

sources.name: USGS Significant Earthquakes (30 days)
sources.description: USGS Earthquake Hazards Program GeoJSON summary feed: significant events (mag >= 4.5 with high impact score) over the trailing 30 days. Envelope: {type: FeatureCollection, metadata:{title, count, generated, api}, features:[{type: Feature, id, properties:{mag, place, time (epoch ms), updated (epoch ms), url, felt, cdi, mmi, alert (green/yellow/orange/red), status, tsunami (0/1), sig, magType, type, title, ...}, geometry:{type: Point, coordinates:[lon, lat, depth_km]}}]}. Public, no auth, refreshes every 5-15 min upstream.

args.name: Quake Trend
args.features_description: Adds row-level calendar features parsed from event_time (year, month, quarter, day_of_week, iso_week). Row-level significant-earthquake detail.
args.stats_description: Long-form quake statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over PAGER alert level and magnitude type). Includes daily_count, 7-day rolling counts, z-score anomalies vs baseline (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True). Use to spot clusters of orange/red alerts or unusual magType distribution.

outputs.name: USGS Quake Detail
outputs.description: Row-level significant earthquakes (mag>=4.5) from the USGS 30-day GeoJSON summary feed. Includes mag, place, time_ms (epoch), event_time (ISO), alert (green/yellow/orange/red PAGER level), tsunami (0/1), sig (impact score), felt (DYFI count), cdi (community intensity), mmi (Modified Mercalli), mag_type, event_type, url, lon, lat, depth_km. Plus calendar features. Source: earthquake.usgs.gov feed. Refresh: daily.

outputs.name: USGS Quake Stats
outputs.description: Long-form significant-earthquake trend statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over PAGER alert level and magnitude type). Includes 7-day rolling counts, z-score anomalies, lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Joinable from Tableau on (dimension, value, year, month). Use to identify unusual clusters of orange/red-alert events.
